question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

I remember________ when she used to wash dishes in a restaurant.
solution:
The correct answer is '**the time**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**the time**" is used to refer to a specific period in the past when something happened.
 
• In this context, it refers to recalling a specific period when she used to wash dishes in a restaurant.
 
• The other options: "**the business**," "**the area**," and "**the profile**" do not fit the context appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *I remember the time__ when she used to wash dishes in a restaurant.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Business (व्यवसाय)**: refers to an organization or enterprising entity engaged in commercial, industrial, or professional activities.
 
• **Area (क्षेत्र)**: refers to a particular geographical region or space.
 
• **Profile (प्रोफ़ाइल)**: refers to a description or representation of someone's career, skills, or experience.
